PLATEGA_MERCHANT_ID.description: Your Platega **MerchantId** (UUID). Find it in the Platega dashboard under **Settings**.

PLATEGA_SECRET.description: Your Platega **API key** (`X-Secret`), from the same **Settings** page. Never share it.

SELLAUTH_API_KEY.description: SellAuth API key from [Account > Developers](https://dash.sellauth.com/api). Scope it to your shop.

SELLAUTH_SHOP_ID.description: Your numeric SellAuth shop ID (the number in API URLs like `/shops/1/`).

SELLAUTH_SHOP_URL.description: Your storefront URL, e.g. `https://yourshop.mysellauth.com`. Buyers are returned to `<url>/checkout/<ref>`.

PLATEGA_PAYMENT_METHOD.description: Platega payment method number: 2 = SBP QR, 3 = ERIP, 11 = card acquiring, 12 = international, 13 = crypto, 14 = Sberpay. Must be enabled on your account.

PLATEGA_MARKUP_PCT.description: Percent added on top of the converted RUB amount to cover rate changes, e.g. `2`. Use `0` for none.
